SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssoldListMapper.getTotalCount : 전체게시글수 */ COUNT(*) FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT = #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} /* 작성자 조회 */
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssoldListMapper.selectBbssoldList : 본인상담게시판 */ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ --, BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ --, BB.FRST_RGTR_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS USE_YN /* 위기유형구분명 */ , CASE WHEN DD.INDEX_SN IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS SRVY_RESULT_YN /* 설문조사여부 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , (SELECT MAX(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , (SELECT MAX(BB.FRST_RGTR_ID ) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS REPLY_CNT /* 댓글수 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제상태대분류구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제원인대분류구분코드 FROM AYE100 AA /* 게시판 */ --, AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ , SAC100 CC /* 공통코드 */ , AYE195 DD WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 게시판유형구분코드 : 도담샘 솔로봇댓글 */ --AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD (+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD --AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO (+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD AND DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO (+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND DD.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD (+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT = #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} /* 작성자 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssoldListMapper.selectBbssoldDetail : 상세게시판 */ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목 */ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , AA.DSCSN_THMA_NM AS DSCSN_THMA_NM /* 상담주제 */ /* 질의응답 */ , REPLACE(AA.ANS_CN, '|', '
') AS ANS_CN /* 질의응답 */ , AA.BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 아이피 */ , BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS SXDC_SE_CD /* 성별 */ , AA.NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT /* 글비번 */ , AA.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YR /* 출생년도 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS /* 조회수 */ , AA.EML_ADDR_ENCPT /* 이메일주소 */ , AA.HPGE_URL_ADDR /* 홈페이지주소 */ --, AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기관리구분 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD) AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD --위기관리구분 , AA.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담사명 */ , AA.SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN /* 슈퍼비전선정여부 */ , ( SELECT INDEX_SN FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS INDEX_SN/*상담자일련번호*/ , ( SELECT REG_DT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS REG_DT/*상담자배정일자*/ , ( SELECT CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS CONSTT_ID/*상담자아이디*/ , ( SELECT A1.MEMO_NM FROM AYA160 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS MEMO_NM/*메모*/ , AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD , AA.PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_MLSFC_SE_CD , AA.PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_STTS_SCLAS_SE_CD , AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD , AA.PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD AS PROBM_CAS_SCLAS_SE_CD , AA.ETC_CN AS ETC_CN FROM AYE100 AA , SAC100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 게시판유형구분코드 : 도담샘 솔로봇댓글 */ AND BB.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'SXDC_SE_CD' /* 공통코드ID */ AND BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE (+) = AA.SXDC_SE_CD

SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글번호 */ , CMNT_ESNTAL_NO /* 댓글고유번호 */ , CMNT_CN /* 댓글내용 */ , TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 수정일자 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID , TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT , WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , #{loginId} AS LOGIN_ID FROM AYE110 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND ( DEL_YN != 'Y' OR DEL_YN IS NULL )
SELECT COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) FROM AYA110 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
SELECT COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) FROM AYA120 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}
mapper.insert: INSERT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssoldListMapper.insertReply : 게시글등록 */ INTO AYE110 ( BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글번호 */ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글코드 */ , CMNT_ESNTAL_NO /* 댓글고유번호 */ , CMNT_CN /* 댓글내용 */ , WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 아이피 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ) VALUES ( #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , '02' /* 게시글구분코드 */ , ( SELECT NVL(MAX(CMNT_ESNTAL_NO),0) +1 FROM AYE110 WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 게시글구분코드 */ ) , #{CMNT_CN} , C##RG.ENC_B64(#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}) , #{CNTN_IP_ADDR} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssoldListMapper.deleteBbssold : 게시글삭제 */ AYE100 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 게시판유형구분코드 */

UPDATE /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssoldListMapper.bbssoldDtlCnt : 게시글조회수 */ AYE100 SET RDCNT_NOCS = NVL(RDCNT_NOCS, 0) +1 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02'

mapper.update: INSERT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssolListMapper.updateBbssolDetail : 상담자배정 추가 */ INTO AYA150 ( INDEX_SN , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , CONSTT_ID , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT , REG_DT , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( AYA150_SQ01.NEXTVAL , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , '02' /* 솔로봇 */ , #{USER_ID} , ( SELECT BB.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 AA , SCA100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND BB.ENFSN_NO = AA.ENFSN_NO ) , #{WORK_YMD} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbssoldListMapper.insertCrisisBoard : 솔로봇채팅 위기유형저장 */ INTO AYA110 ( INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글구분코드 */ , CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(INDEX_SN),0) +1 FROM AYA110 ) , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , '02' , #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO AYA150 (/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbscttListMapper : 비밀게시판 상담사 4 (등록)*/ INDEX_SN /*일련번호*/ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , CONSTT_ID /*상담자아이디*/ , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상다자명*/ , USE_YN /*사용여부*/ , REG_DT /*등록일시*/ , DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ ) VALUES ( AYA150_SQ01.NEXTVAL /*일련번호*/ , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글고유번호*/ , '02' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , #{CONSTT_ID} /*상담자아이디*/ , (SELECT DD.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND #{CONSTT_ID} = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , 'Y' /*사용여부*/ , #{REG_DT} /*등록일시*/ , 'N' /*삭제여부*/ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /*최초등록아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최초등록일*/ , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ )
